full_prompt_en: A square grotesque comic illustration places a huge skull-like creature's face in the center of a densely filled blue-black field. Two enormous white eyes bulge outward, each with a small bright blue iris and a tiny black pupil. Heavy ridged brows curve around them. Beneath, a flattened triangular nasal opening and a broad black mouth filled with tiny uneven teeth make the expression wildly alarmed. The creature's head appears to grow out of an almost organic crowd of smaller skulls, eyes, clustered round forms, and writhing line patterns. The surrounding marks are so dense that they read first as a roiling texture, then reveal miniature faces and cavities on closer inspection. The upper left is paler and more cream-colored; the right becomes deeper blue. Across the lower foreground sweeps a thick crimson-magenta curved band, like the lip of a vast container or a draped stripe, wrapping upward at the right edge. Its fine parallel red hatching contrasts with the blue irregularity above. The main skull remains mostly white and gray, with black contour lines and densely hatched shadow around eye sockets, cheeks, and teeth. The composition is cropped close: the upper creature continues beyond the top edge, and the red curve cuts off the lower mass. No horizon or ordinary environment appears. The comic linework is obsessive, playful, and unsettling, mixing crosshatching, stippling, and tiny repeated faces. Strong red-blue color opposition and the eyes' white disks create the principal focal structure. No readable letters or captions appear. The image feels like a lurid printed horror-comedy cover, full of exaggerated fear and intricate visual noise.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形怪诞漫画插画把一张巨大的骷髅般怪物脸放在极度密集的蓝黑画域中央。两只巨大白眼鼓出，各有小亮蓝虹膜和微小黑瞳。厚重带脊眉弧围住眼睛。其下是压扁三角鼻洞和装满细小不齐牙齿的宽黑大口，神情狂乱惊惧。怪物头似乎从一个近乎有机的小骷髅、眼、圆团和扭动线纹群中生长出来。周围记号密到初看是翻滚纹理，近看才发现微型面孔与孔洞。左上较浅偏奶油色，右侧转为深蓝。下前景一道厚厚绯红洋红弧带扫过，像巨大容器口或垂布条，在右缘向上卷。其细密平行红排线与上方蓝色不规则纹理相对。主骷髅大体白灰，黑轮廓与密排线在眼窝、脸颊和牙边制造阴影。构图极近裁切：上方怪物延出顶边，红弧切断下部团块。没有地平线或普通环境。漫画线描近乎偏执，又顽皮又令人不安，混合交叉排线、点描和微型重复脸。强红蓝对色与白眼圆盘构成主要焦点结构。没有可读字母或标题。画面像俗艳印刷的恐怖喜剧封面，充满夸张恐惧和繁复视觉噪声。
style_prompt_en: The grotesque printed-comic treatment overwhelms the field with tiny crosshatched shapes, stippled pockets, repeated eyes and skull-like curls. One oversized pale face-like mass and two glaring white disks remain legible against a turbulent blue-black surround. A thick crimson-magenta curve sweeps across the lower field, bringing a clean broad countershape to the intricate upper texture. Bright cyan touches, cream paper, black ink, and deep cobalt sharpen the red-blue opposition. Contours are elastic and caricatured, with exaggerated expression and packed microdetail. Close cropping removes spatial context and makes texture feel continuous beyond the frame. The finish is lurid, witty, and unsettling, like an aged horror-comedy print with obsessive hand-drawn linework.
style_prompt_zh: 怪诞印刷漫画处理用微型交叉排线形、点描暗窝、重复眼点与骷髅般卷曲挤满画域。一处过大浅色脸状团块和两只瞪视白圆仍能从翻滚蓝黑周围读出。厚绯红洋红曲带扫过下方，用干净宽阔对形平衡上部精密纹理。亮青点、奶油纸、黑墨和深钴蓝强化红蓝对立。轮廓有弹性、夸张，表情放大，微细节拥挤。近裁切去掉空间上下文，让纹理像在框外继续。完成度俗艳、机智又令人不安，仿佛有偏执手绘线条的旧恐怖喜剧印刷品。
theme_en: A bulging-eyed skull creature rises from a packed blue mass above a red curved band
theme_zh: 蓝色密集纹样里鼓眼骷髅怪物升起，下方横过红色弧带
name: Basil Wolverton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
